item.title: FAANG vs Startup
item.description: I’m a software engineer now. It took me a few years to actually call myself that but now that I’ve been around the block for over 6 years I think I can finally claim the title. I’ve been working at Amazon (which is one of the famous FAANGs) for 6 months now. Prior to this I was working at a startup for 3 years. So I’m in a good position to write on this clickbaity title that hundreds of creators have made videos on.

item.title: How I Use AI
item.description: Unless you live under a rock you must have heard of Artificial Intelligence (AI). It is an umbrella term for any computer program that can perform human-like intelligent tasks (eg. identifying animals) but has come to be interchangeable with Generative AI like ChatGPT. Generative AI is, as the name suggests, any tool that “generates” output like a human would. It could be an essay, an image or code. ChatGPT was not the first Generative AI app but it’s selling point was so dead simple it became the most popular very quickly.

item.title: Software Engineering Interview Preparation
item.description: While looking for software engineering jobs, I’ve gone through a lot of preparation material. Typically, technical interviews will take 3 forms - Data Structures and Algorithms System Design Low-level Design / Object-oriented Design The links above have all my notes compiled in one place for each topic. I’m using Notion to write these notes. A few disclaimers: This is not complete and I will keep adding to these as I study more I have added sources wherever possible for readers to read more from Since this is manually written there are bound to be errors.
